scene.label: Act 2, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Milan. A room in the Duke's palace
scene.location: Milan. A room in the Duke's palace

content.text: Enter Valentine, Silvia, Thurio and Speed.

lines.text: Servant!
lines.plainText: Servant

lines.text: Mistress?
lines.plainText: Mistress

lines.text: Master, Sir Thurio frowns on you.
lines.plainText: Master Sir Thurio frowns on you

lines.text: Ay, boy, it's for love.
lines.plainText: Ay boy it's for love

lines.text: Not of you.
lines.plainText: Not of you

lines.text: Of my mistress, then.
lines.plainText: Of my mistress then

lines.text: 'Twere good you knocked him.
lines.plainText: 'Twere good you knocked him

lines.text: Servant, you are sad.
lines.plainText: Servant you are sad

lines.text: Indeed, madam, I seem so.
lines.plainText: Indeed madam I seem so

lines.text: Seem you that you are not?
lines.plainText: Seem you that you are not

lines.text: Haply I do.
lines.plainText: Haply I do

lines.text: So do counterfeits.
lines.plainText: So do counterfeits

lines.text: So do you.
lines.plainText: So do you

lines.text: What seem I that I am not?
lines.plainText: What seem I that I am not

lines.text: Wise.
lines.plainText: Wise

lines.text: What instance of the contrary?
lines.plainText: What instance of the contrary

lines.text: Your folly.
lines.plainText: Your folly

lines.text: And how quote you my folly?
lines.plainText: And how quote you my folly

lines.text: I quote it in your jerkin.
lines.plainText: I quote it in your jerkin

lines.text: My jerkin is a doublet.
lines.plainText: My jerkin is a doublet

lines.text: Well, then, I'll double your folly.
lines.plainText: Well then I'll double your folly

lines.text: How!
lines.plainText: How

lines.text: What, angry, Sir Thurio? Do you change colour?
lines.plainText: What angry Sir Thurio Do you change colour

lines.text: Give him leave, madam, he is a kind of chameleon.
lines.plainText: Give him leave madam he is a kind of chameleon

lines.text: That hath more mind to feed on your blood than live in your air.
lines.plainText: That hath more mind to feed on your blood than live in your air

lines.text: You have said, sir.
lines.plainText: You have said sir

lines.text: Ay, sir, and done too, for this time.
lines.plainText: Ay sir and done too for this time

lines.text: I know it well, sir. You always end ere you begin.
lines.plainText: I know it well sir You always end ere you begin

lines.text: A fine volley of words, gentlemen, and quickly shot off.
lines.plainText: A fine volley of words gentlemen and quickly shot off

lines.text: 'Tis indeed, madam, we thank the giver.
lines.plainText: 'Tis indeed madam we thank the giver

lines.text: Who is that, servant?
lines.plainText: Who is that servant

lines.text: Yourself, sweet lady, for you gave the fire. Sir Thurio borrows his wit from your ladyship's looks, and spends what he borrows kindly in your company.
lines.plainText: Yourself sweet lady for you gave the fire Sir Thurio borrows his wit from your ladyship's looks and spends what he borrows kindly in your company

lines.text: Sir, if you spend word for word with me, I shall make your wit bankrupt.
lines.plainText: Sir if you spend word for word with me I shall make your wit bankrupt

lines.text: I know it well, sir. You have an exchequer of words and, I think, no other treasure to give your followers, for it appears by their bare liveries that they live by your bare words.
lines.plainText: I know it well sir You have an exchequer of words and I think no other treasure to give your followers for it appears by their bare liveries that they live by your bare words

lines.text: No more, gentlemen, no more. Here comes my father.
lines.plainText: No more gentlemen no more Here comes my father

lines.text: Now, daughter Silvia, you are hard beset.
lines.plainText: Now daughter Silvia you are hard beset

lines.text: Sir Valentine, your father is in good health.
lines.plainText: Sir Valentine your father is in good health

lines.text: What say you to a letter from your friends
lines.plainText: What say you to a letter from your friends

lines.text: Of much good news?
lines.plainText: Of much good news

lines.text: My lord, I will be thankful
lines.plainText: My lord I will be thankful

lines.text: To any happy messenger from thence.
lines.plainText: To any happy messenger from thence

lines.text: Know ye Don Antonio, your countryman?
lines.plainText: Know ye Don Antonio your countryman

lines.text: Ay, my good lord, I know the gentleman
lines.plainText: Ay my good lord I know the gentleman

lines.text: To be of worth and worthy estimation,
lines.plainText: To be of worth and worthy estimation

lines.text: And not without desert so well reputed.
lines.plainText: And not without desert so well reputed

lines.text: Hath he not a son?
lines.plainText: Hath he not a son

lines.text: Ay, my good lord, a son that well deserves
lines.plainText: Ay my good lord a son that well deserves

lines.text: The honour and regard of such a father.
lines.plainText: The honour and regard of such a father

lines.text: You know him well?
lines.plainText: You know him well

lines.text: I knew him as myself, for from our infancy
lines.plainText: I knew him as myself for from our infancy

lines.text: We have conversed and spent our hours together.
lines.plainText: We have conversed and spent our hours together

lines.text: And though myself have been an idle truant,
lines.plainText: And though myself have been an idle truant

lines.text: Omitting the sweet benefit of time
lines.plainText: Omitting the sweet benefit of time

lines.text: To clothe mine age with angel-like perfection,
lines.plainText: To clothe mine age with angellike perfection

lines.text: Yet hath Sir Proteus, for that's his name,
lines.plainText: Yet hath Sir Proteus for that's his name

lines.text: Made use and fair advantage of his days:
lines.plainText: Made use and fair advantage of his days

lines.text: His years but young, but his experience old;
lines.plainText: His years but young but his experience old

lines.text: His head unmellowed, but his judgement ripe;
lines.plainText: His head unmellowed but his judgement ripe

lines.text: And in a word, for far behind his worth
lines.plainText: And in a word for far behind his worth

lines.text: Comes all the praises that I now bestow,
lines.plainText: Comes all the praises that I now bestow

lines.text: He is complete in feature and in mind,
lines.plainText: He is complete in feature and in mind

lines.text: With all good grace to grace a gentleman.
lines.plainText: With all good grace to grace a gentleman

lines.text: Beshrew me, sir, but if he make this good,
lines.plainText: Beshrew me sir but if he make this good

lines.text: He is as worthy for an empress' love
lines.plainText: He is as worthy for an empress' love

lines.text: As meet to be an emperor's counsellor.
lines.plainText: As meet to be an emperor's counsellor

lines.text: Well, sir, this gentleman is come to me
lines.plainText: Well sir this gentleman is come to me

lines.text: With commendation from great potentates,
lines.plainText: With commendation from great potentates

lines.text: And here he means to spend his time awhile.
lines.plainText: And here he means to spend his time awhile

lines.text: I think 'tis no unwelcome news to you.
lines.plainText: I think 'tis no unwelcome news to you

lines.text: Should I have wished a thing, it had been he.
lines.plainText: Should I have wished a thing it had been he

lines.text: Welcome him then according to his worth.
lines.plainText: Welcome him then according to his worth

lines.text: Silvia, I speak to you, and you, Sir Thurio.
lines.plainText: Silvia I speak to you and you Sir Thurio

lines.text: For Valentine, I need not cite him to it.
lines.plainText: For Valentine I need not cite him to it

lines.text: I will send him hither to you presently.
lines.plainText: I will send him hither to you presently

lines.text: This is the gentleman I told your ladyship
lines.plainText: This is the gentleman I told your ladyship

lines.text: Had come along with me but that his mistresss
lines.plainText: Had come along with me but that his mistresss

lines.text: Did hold his eyes locked in her crystal looks.
lines.plainText: Did hold his eyes locked in her crystal looks

lines.text: Belike that now she hath enfranchised them
lines.plainText: Belike that now she hath enfranchised them

lines.text: Upon some other pawn for fealty.
lines.plainText: Upon some other pawn for fealty

lines.text: Nay, sure, I think she holds them prisoners still.
lines.plainText: Nay sure I think she holds them prisoners still

lines.text: Nay, then, he should be blind, and being blind
lines.plainText: Nay then he should be blind and being blind

lines.text: How could he see his way to seek out you?
lines.plainText: How could he see his way to seek out you

lines.text: Why, lady, Love hath twenty pair of eyes.
lines.plainText: Why lady Love hath twenty pair of eyes

lines.text: They say that Love hath not an eye at all.
lines.plainText: They say that Love hath not an eye at all

lines.text: To see such lovers, Thurio, as yourself.
lines.plainText: To see such lovers Thurio as yourself

lines.text: Upon a homely object, Love can wink.
lines.plainText: Upon a homely object Love can wink

lines.text: Have done, have done. Here comes the gentleman.
lines.plainText: Have done have done Here comes the gentleman

lines.text: Welcome, dear Proteus! Mistress, I beseech you
lines.plainText: Welcome dear Proteus Mistress I beseech you

lines.text: Confirm his welcome with some special favour.
lines.plainText: Confirm his welcome with some special favour

lines.text: His worth is warrant for his welcome hither,
lines.plainText: His worth is warrant for his welcome hither

lines.text: If this be he you oft have wished to hear from.
lines.plainText: If this be he you oft have wished to hear from

lines.text: Mistress, it is. Sweet lady, entertain him
lines.plainText: Mistress it is Sweet lady entertain him

lines.text: To be my fellow-servant to your ladyship.
lines.plainText: To be my fellowservant to your ladyship

lines.text: Too low a mistress for so high a servant.
lines.plainText: Too low a mistress for so high a servant

lines.text: Not so, sweet lady, but too mean a servant
lines.plainText: Not so sweet lady but too mean a servant

lines.text: To have a look of such a worthy mistress.
lines.plainText: To have a look of such a worthy mistress

lines.text: Leave off discourse of disability.
lines.plainText: Leave off discourse of disability

lines.text: Sweet lady, entertain him for your servant.
lines.plainText: Sweet lady entertain him for your servant

lines.text: My duty will I boast of, nothing else.
lines.plainText: My duty will I boast of nothing else

lines.text: And duty never yet did want his meed.
lines.plainText: And duty never yet did want his meed

lines.text: Servant, you are welcome to a worthless mistress.
lines.plainText: Servant you are welcome to a worthless mistress

lines.text: I'll die on him that says so but yourself.
lines.plainText: I'll die on him that says so but yourself

lines.text: That you are welcome?
lines.plainText: That you are welcome

lines.text: That you are worthless.
lines.plainText: That you are worthless

lines.text: Madam, my lord your father would speak with you.
lines.plainText: Madam my lord your father would speak with you

lines.text: I wait upon his pleasure.
lines.plainText: I wait upon his pleasure

lines.text: We'll both attend upon your ladyship.
lines.plainText: We'll both attend upon your ladyship

lines.text: Now, tell me, how do all from whence you came?
lines.plainText: Now tell me how do all from whence you came

lines.text: Your friends are well and have them much commended.
lines.plainText: Your friends are well and have them much commended

lines.text: And how do yours?
lines.plainText: And how do yours

lines.text: I left them all in health.
lines.plainText: I left them all in health

lines.text: How does your lady? And how thrives your love?
lines.plainText: How does your lady And how thrives your love

lines.text: My tales of love were wont to weary you;
lines.plainText: My tales of love were wont to weary you

lines.text: I know you joy not in a love-discourse.
lines.plainText: I know you joy not in a lovediscourse

lines.text: Ay, Proteus, but that life is altered now.
lines.plainText: Ay Proteus but that life is altered now

lines.text: I have done penance for contemning Love,
lines.plainText: I have done penance for contemning Love

lines.text: Whose high imperious thoughts have punished me
lines.plainText: Whose high imperious thoughts have punished me

lines.text: With bitter fasts, with penitential groans,
lines.plainText: With bitter fasts with penitential groans

lines.text: With nightly tears, and daily heart-sore sighs;
lines.plainText: With nightly tears and daily heartsore sighs

lines.text: For in revenge of my contempt of love,
lines.plainText: For in revenge of my contempt of love

lines.text: Love hath chased sleep from my enthralled eyes
lines.plainText: Love hath chased sleep from my enthralled eyes

lines.text: And made them watchers of mine own heart's sorrow.
lines.plainText: And made them watchers of mine own heart's sorrow

lines.text: O gentle Proteus, Love's a mighty lord,
lines.plainText: O gentle Proteus Love's a mighty lord

lines.text: And hath so humbled me as I confess
lines.plainText: And hath so humbled me as I confess

lines.text: There is no woe to his correction,
lines.plainText: There is no woe to his correction

lines.text: Nor to his service no such joy on earth.
lines.plainText: Nor to his service no such joy on earth

lines.text: Now, no discourse, except it be of love;
lines.plainText: Now no discourse except it be of love

lines.text: Now can I break my fast, dine, sup, and sleep
lines.plainText: Now can I break my fast dine sup and sleep

lines.text: Upon the very naked name of love.
lines.plainText: Upon the very naked name of love

lines.text: Enough; I read your fortune in your eye.
lines.plainText: Enough I read your fortune in your eye

lines.text: Was this the idol that you worship so?
lines.plainText: Was this the idol that you worship so

lines.text: Even she; and is she not a heavenly saint?
lines.plainText: Even she and is she not a heavenly saint

lines.text: No, but she is an earthly paragon.
lines.plainText: No but she is an earthly paragon

lines.text: Call her divine.
lines.plainText: Call her divine

lines.text: I will not flatter her.
lines.plainText: I will not flatter her

lines.text: O, flatter me, for love delights in praises.
lines.plainText: O flatter me for love delights in praises

lines.text: When I was sick, you gave me bitter pills,
lines.plainText: When I was sick you gave me bitter pills

lines.text: And I must minister the like to you.
lines.plainText: And I must minister the like to you

lines.text: Then speak the truth by her; if not divine,
lines.plainText: Then speak the truth by her if not divine

lines.text: Yet let her be a principality,
lines.plainText: Yet let her be a principality

lines.text: Sovereign to all the creatures on the earth.
lines.plainText: Sovereign to all the creatures on the earth

lines.text: Except my mistress.
lines.plainText: Except my mistress

lines.text: Sweet, except not any,
lines.plainText: Sweet except not any

lines.text: Except thou wilt except against my love.
lines.plainText: Except thou wilt except against my love

lines.text: Have I not reason to prefer mine own?
lines.plainText: Have I not reason to prefer mine own

lines.text: And I will help thee to prefer her too:
lines.plainText: And I will help thee to prefer her too

lines.text: She shall be dignified with this high honour,
lines.plainText: She shall be dignified with this high honour

lines.text: To bear my lady's train, lest the base earth
lines.plainText: To bear my lady's train lest the base earth

lines.text: Should from her vesture chance to steal a kiss,
lines.plainText: Should from her vesture chance to steal a kiss

lines.text: And, of so great a favour growing proud,
lines.plainText: And of so great a favour growing proud

lines.text: Disdain to root the summer-swelling flower
lines.plainText: Disdain to root the summerswelling flower

lines.text: And make rough winter everlastingly.
lines.plainText: And make rough winter everlastingly

lines.text: Why, Valentine, what braggartism is this?
lines.plainText: Why Valentine what braggartism is this

lines.text: Pardon me, Proteus, all I can is nothing
lines.plainText: Pardon me Proteus all I can is nothing

lines.text: To her, whose worth makes other worthies nothing;
lines.plainText: To her whose worth makes other worthies nothing

lines.text: She is alone.
lines.plainText: She is alone

lines.text: Then let her alone.
lines.plainText: Then let her alone

lines.text: Not for the world! Why, man, she is mine own,
lines.plainText: Not for the world Why man she is mine own

lines.text: And I as rich in having such a jewel
lines.plainText: And I as rich in having such a jewel

lines.text: As twenty seas, if all their sand were pearl,
lines.plainText: As twenty seas if all their sand were pearl

lines.text: The water nectar, and the rocks pure gold.
lines.plainText: The water nectar and the rocks pure gold

lines.text: Forgive me that I do not dream on thee,
lines.plainText: Forgive me that I do not dream on thee

lines.text: Because thou seest me dote upon my love.
lines.plainText: Because thou seest me dote upon my love

lines.text: My foolish rival, that her father likes
lines.plainText: My foolish rival that her father likes

lines.text: Only for his possessions are so huge,
lines.plainText: Only for his possessions are so huge

lines.text: Is gone with her along, and I must after,
lines.plainText: Is gone with her along and I must after

lines.text: For love, thou know'st, is full of jealousy.
lines.plainText: For love thou know'st is full of jealousy

lines.text: But she loves you?
lines.plainText: But she loves you

lines.text: Ay, and we are betrothed; nay more, our marriage hour,
lines.plainText: Ay and we are betrothed nay more our marriage hour

lines.text: With all the cunning manner of our flight,
lines.plainText: With all the cunning manner of our flight

lines.text: Determined of: how I must climb her window,
lines.plainText: Determined of how I must climb her window

lines.text: The ladder made of cords, and all the means
lines.plainText: The ladder made of cords and all the means

lines.text: Plotted and 'greed on for my happiness.
lines.plainText: Plotted and 'greed on for my happiness

lines.text: Good Proteus, go with me to my chamber,
lines.plainText: Good Proteus go with me to my chamber

lines.text: In these affairs to aid me with thy counsel.
lines.plainText: In these affairs to aid me with thy counsel

lines.text: Go on before; I shall enquire you forth.
lines.plainText: Go on before I shall enquire you forth

lines.text: I must unto the road to disembark
lines.plainText: I must unto the road to disembark

lines.text: Some necessaries that I needs must use,
lines.plainText: Some necessaries that I needs must use

lines.text: And then I'll presently attend you.
lines.plainText: And then I'll presently attend you

lines.text: Will you make haste?
lines.plainText: Will you make haste

lines.text: I will.
lines.plainText: I will
